aboutPage.whoTitle: Technology expertise at the service of business
aboutPage.whoText: Founded in Algeria in 2010, CaptureDoc designs and deploys intelligent automation platforms for the document processes of large organizations. As Master VAD (Value-Added Distributor) for Tungsten Automation and Xerox DocuShare in the MENA region, we help more than 50 clients across 13+ countries turn their document chains into automated, reliable and auditable workflows — backed by a team of 50+ certified consultants.

privacySections.d: CaptureDoc, headquartered at 187 lot Bouchadou 2, N°32, Chéraga 16084, Algiers, Algeria, is responsible for processing personal data collected through this website. For any question about your data, contact us at info@capturedoc.com or +213 551 31 97 51.

We collect the information you submit through the contact form: name, surname, email address, phone number, country, and the content of your message. Technical browsing data may also be collected to improve our services.

Your data is used to respond to quote, demo or support requests, to manage our business relationship, and to improve our services. It is never sold or shared with third parties for commercial purposes.

Data is kept for the duration necessary to the described purposes, then archived or deleted in accordance with applicable regulations, including Law 18-07 on the protection of personal data. We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure the security and confidentiality of your data.
Under Law 18-07, you have rights of access, rectification, objection and deletion over your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at info@capturedoc.com.
